case.pattern_description: Several unrelated customers' cards paid the same recipient email domain (sc.rr.com) in a short spike that the bank had rarely seen before; this case card is one of 17 cards in the spike. It matches none of the documented typologies: each card's own purchases look ordinary, and the abuse only shows across customers. It was found by a detector the agent discovered in the closed cases and an L2 manager approved (approval 54983eaa-faa5-4569-b6ce-e6602d25072f), which then fired on this alert.

Backtest on the closed cases: 8 confirmed-fraud hits, 0 cleared hits, population rate 0.01%, lift 18.0

Card C01727-K2 already has 5 confirmed-fraud closed case(s) (CC-0723, CC-1501, CC-1833, CC-1975). The account key is not usable in January, so the precedent is read at card level, where it is weaker: on cards of this size an earlier confirmed case made a new alert about 3.9 times as likely to be fraud

sar.narrative: This report concerns customer C01727, card C01727-K2, issued as a visa debit. Between 2017-01-17 and 2017-01-28, 3 transaction(s) totalling $967.68 were identified as part of one fraud episode, beginning with transaction 3660261. The activity took place online, product code(s) C, billing region(s) 231. The transactions were purchases paying one recipient email domain that suddenly drew payments from several unrelated customers' cards. The activity is assessed as an undocumented coordinated pattern: R_emaildomain sc.rr.com was paid by 4 cards in the 1 day up to 2017-01-28 against 35 card-days in the previous 56 days; Card C01727-K2 already has 5 confirmed-fraud closed case. The account key is not usable in January, so the precedent is read at card level, where it is weaker: on cards of this size an earlier confirmed case made a new alert about 3.9 times as likely to be fraud. The shared element (recipient email domain sc.rr.com) links this activity to 16 other card(s), including C00534-K2, C01357-K1, C01507-K1, C01594-K1, which indicates a common actor across cardholders. Earlier confirmed cases CC-0723, CC-1833, CC-1501 show the same pattern. The cardholder has not yet been contacted. The bank has recommended BLOCK_CARD, MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS and opened an internal case; the report is filed under R9, §3a.

stop_reason: Fraud probability 0.88 is at or above 0.85 with 2 independent evidence groups (network, history), so section 6 allows a decision without asking the customer; further queries would not change the actions.
